# GitHub Actions Secrets (Repository Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions)
# Required for scheduled scraping workflows

# ── Optional: API Keys ──────────────────────────────────────
# APOLLO_API_KEY=   # Apollo.io B2B search
# HUNTER_API_KEY=   # Hunter.io email finder

# ── Optional: Notifications ────────────────────────────────────
# DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL=   # Post results to Discord
# SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL=     # Post results to Slack

# ── Optional: Cloud Storage ───────────────────────────────────
# AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
# AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=
# S3_BUCKET=   # Upload results to S3
